title: Correct stevensite primary-source and supplement locators
body:
The new `data/records/stevensite.yaml` draft cites **Table S6** for the EDS magnesium comparison in the biological mechanism evidence. The actual location is the table embedded in **Figure S6**, supplementary PDF page 17, of [Arizaleta et al., DOI 10.1016/j.gca.2025.12.052](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.gca.2025.12.052). [The original supplement](https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S0016703725007446-mmc1.pdf) labels Table S6 as modeled carbonate saturation indices on pages 12–13.

The author flagged the locator after freezing the draft; the independent reviewer and coordinator checked the original graphic. The statement that normalized Mg mass percentage is lower in the coating interaction volume remains supported. This is a minor traceability error, not a change to the accepted phase interpretation or a new recovery measurement.

Frozen initial record SHA-256: `dbfb3d06278c111f64dec7da731fb214f18f70d1e12aec11600524d1b957d310`.

Acceptance criteria:

- Preserve the initial independent native finding before changing the owner.
- Replace the erroneous locator with the embedded table in Figure S6, page 17; preserve the scientific scope and uncertainty.
- Add a canonical EDIT history session and distinct inline change event; correct any companion dossier locator.
- Save a successor review with the same stable issue key, exact predecessor occurrence, and final owner hash.
- Repeat affected validation and rendered-page checks, including the final batch gates and trusted-base history/review checks.

Open and closed GitHub issues were checked through the fully paginated API immediately before filing; no existing stevensite or exact-DOI issue matched.

Further independent review expanded the same locator correction:

- Coating morphology is in main Figure 5; supplementary Figures S5 and S6 provide XRD and EDS respectively.
- Figures S1–S4 and Table S1 concern diffraction, biotic photographs and digested-clay chemistry; solution measurements are in Tables S2–S3.
- Supplementary Figure S4, rather than the biotic photographs in Figure S3, supplies post-abiotic diffraction.
- Main Section 4.1 discusses biological mechanisms and Section 4.2 abiotic interpretation; relevant record explanations had these reversed.

Saved initial observations are `20261014T190151Z-stevensite-round79-locator-initial` and `20261014T190402Z-stevensite-round79-locator-followup` under `reviews/structured/`. The final successor must explicitly resolve **both F1 occurrences** (`stevensite-round79-eds-figure-locator`) and **F2** in the expanded observation (`stevensite-round79-adjacent-source-locators`). A related-review link alone does not retire a finding. Both original bundles remain immutable.

One coherent record correction and EDIT session should fix these confirmed locators while preserving the accepted scientific claims. The initial batch gate passed with the frozen original bytes; corrected final gates are required after this edit.
